messages:
Mara (People Ops): Thanks everyone — quick follow-up thread from the leadership huddle earlier. Drop short questions about the review cycle, leveling, promos, comp, or benefits and we'll triage. Tagging @Jon and @Alex for level/comp specifics.
Leah (Eng Manager): Quick one — for L4->L5 promotions, do we still require a 3rd-party cross-team reference or is manager + peer sufficient?
Alex (Talent): Manager + 1 cross-functional peer is the minimum now. We keep the 3rd formal reference optional for high-risk role moves.
Sanjay (Dir, Product): Is there an ETA on when the new band midpoints will be published? People asked about benchmarks for next round.
Mara (People Ops): We’ll publish updated band midpoints and the comp rubric next Wednesday (internal doc link posted). HR bot will post a short summary.
hr-bot: Posted: https://redwood-internal/reports/comp-band-midpoints-2026 (summary pinned) :spiral_note_pad:
Jon (CTO): On promotion criteria: remember we evaluate scope + impact + independence. Examples help — please attach 1-2 short bullet examples in the packet.
Leah (Eng Manager): Thanks. Another practical Q: if a promo is approved retroactively (effective date earlier than approval), does the raise apply from the effective date or approval date?
Alex (Talent): Raises are backdated to the effective date stated in the promotion packet, as long as payroll cutoff windows are respected. If payroll missed it, Talent will do an off-cycle adjustment next pay period.
Leah (Eng Manager): Cool.
Sanjay (Dir, Product): How strict is the calibration rubric? Are there hard score cutoffs or is it more guidance?
Mara (People Ops): Calibration is a guidance-first process — scores are starting points, not hard gates. Calibration meetings are where we align across managers; exceptions happen but need documentation.
Jon (CTO): To add: for critical IC growth tracks we sometimes fast-track promotions if evidence is strong (impact + customer/ops references). We discuss those in exec syncs.
Leah (Eng Manager): Casual ask — can managers see anonymized peer feedback before packet submission? Some want to iterate.
Mara (People Ops): We can share anonymized summaries pre-submission on request. Send me a DM with the packet name.
Leah (Eng Manager): Will do, thanks.
Sanjay (Dir, Product): Benefits question: open enrollment changes — any big plan changes to call out?
Alex (Talent): Mostly network and dental provider updates. HSA contribution limits bumped. No change to base medical plan tiers. Full summary in benefits doc link.
Mara (People Ops): Also a reminder on the appeal window: employees have 10 business days after notification to request a review. Managers should cc People Ops on any appeal threads.
Leah (Eng Manager): Good to know.
Jon (CTO): One last note — for teams heavily using Dedicated and Private deployments, comp signals are trending up due to hiring market. If you have retention concerns, flag Talent early.
Alex (Talent): Agreed. If someone is on a retention conversation, escalate to me and include a short note about impact and counteroffer risk.
Mara (People Ops): Action items: 1) Alex publishes band midpoints Wed, 2) Mara will post the calibration cheat sheet + example bullets, 3) execs will review fast-track list next Monday. If anything urgent, ping me. :thumbsup:
Leah (Eng Manager): Thanks — very helpful.
hr-bot: Reminder: promo packet template -> `/templates/promo-packet.md` and timeline snippet: `submit by Fri -> calibration week -> decisions following Tues`
Mara (People Ops): Closing this thread — will consolidate into the follow-up doc and DM owners. If you asked a question that didn't get answered, @mention me here and I'll prioritize. :wave:
